subject: alt-d
title: ALT.D.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 328 (R(AS)CM(I)-12). ALT-D (alternative definitions) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: POL-DY (political dynamics) and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From POL-DY: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From PHY-U-P: INFO-DS (information dissemination). T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is on a dotted line from PHY-U-P. From INFO-DS: IDY-G-ACT, TF-SH (transfer shifts) and PRI-INFO (principle information). PER-TRS (perceived transition) is on a dotted line from TF-SH. From PRI-INFO: PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance).
